# `/workflow-library` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /workflow-library/v1

`listCompleteWorkflowLibraryV1` — List complete workflow library

This lists all triggers, actions, and operators in the library

- Scopes: sp:workflow:manage, sp:workflow:read
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
- Returns 200: array of object

### GET /workflow-library/v1/actions

`listWorkflowLibraryActionsV1` — List workflow library actions

This lists the workflow actions available to you.

- Scopes: sp:workflow:manage, sp:workflow:read
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq — e.g. `id eq "sp:create-campaign"`
- Returns 200: array of workflowlibraryaction

### GET /workflow-library/v1/triggers

`listWorkflowLibraryTriggersV1` — List workflow library triggers

This lists the workflow triggers available to you

- Scopes: sp:workflow:manage, sp:workflow:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq; name: eq; type: eq — e.g. `id eq "idn:identity-attributes-changed"`
- Returns 200: array of workflowlibrarytrigger

### GET /workflow-library/v1/operators

`listWorkflowLibraryOperatorsV1` — List workflow library operators

This lists the workflow operators available to you

- Scopes: sp:workflow:manage, sp:workflow:read
- Returns 200: array of workflowlibraryoperator
